name: OpticalNeuromorphicEikonal_complex_512
description:
Pathfinding benchmark dataset for GPU-accelerated navigation algorithms.

Dataset: complex_512
Grid Size: 512x512 (262,144 cells)
Obstacle Density: 30%
Speed Field: random
Random Seed: 7

This tabular dataset represents a 2D pathfinding problem. Each row is one grid cell.

The Optical Neuromorphic Eikonal Solver achieves:
- 30-300x speedup over CPU Dijkstra (average: 135x)
- Sub-1% accuracy (0.64% mean absolute error)
- Near-optimal paths (1.025x optimal length)
- Real-time performance (2-4ms per query on 512x512 grids)

Columns:
- x, y: Grid coordinates (0 to size-1)
- is_obstacle: 1.0 if cell blocked, 0.0 if free
- speed: Propagation speed (1.0 = normal, higher = faster, lower = slower)
- is_source: 1.0 if this is the start point, 0.0 otherwise
- is_target: 1.0 if this is the goal point, 0.0 otherwise  
- grid_width, grid_height: Dimensions of the full grid

Use case: Evaluate pathfinding algorithms on structured grids with obstacles and variable costs.

Paper and Code:
- GitHub: https://github.com/Agnuxo1/optical-neuromorphic-eikonal-solver
- HuggingFace Datasets: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Agnuxo/optical-neuromorphic-eikonal-benchmarks
- Interactive Demo: https://huggingface.co/spaces/Agnuxo/optical-neuromorphic-pathfinding-demo
